causality_tests.failure_condition: Any target at or before the prefix boundary changes.
causality_tests.name: future_truncation
causality_tests.procedure: Delete all later bars and compare prefix feature and target bytes.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Any earlier feature or target changes.
causality_tests.name: future_corruption
causality_tests.procedure: Replace every post-boundary OHLC/volume field with extreme finite sentinels.

causality_tests.failure_condition: An appended suffix changes any prefix target.
causality_tests.name: append_invariance
causality_tests.procedure: Compare prefix-only and extended clean replays at identical decision boundaries.

causality_tests.failure_condition: A bar later than c(t), an ineligible symbol, or a non-grid substitute changes the target at t.
causality_tests.name: availability_and_membership
causality_tests.procedure: Inject boundary-adjacent and ineligible rows and assert exact cutoff/grid/current-universe masks.

causality_tests.failure_condition: Clean processes differ in feature hashes, membership, or target bytes.
causality_tests.name: deterministic_rerun
causality_tests.procedure: Replay identical inputs twice using canonical runtime seed 20260801; namespace 2026080102 labels tests only.

decision_contract.insufficient_or_off_grid: return empty mapping to request flat
decision_contract.rebalance_rule: j modulo rebalance_bars equals zero; reference rebalance_bars=3

derived_features.availability: both adjacent closes belong to exact bars with close_time<=c(t)
derived_features.missing_rule: invalid if either close is missing, non-finite, non-positive, duplicated, or not exactly 8h adjacent

derived_features.availability: complete W=3*L_trend return slots ending at the exact anchor
derived_features.missing_rule: all W returns and W+1 closes are required; no partial horizon or imputation
invalid unless quote_volume>1e-12 and 0<=taker_buy_quote_volume<=quote_volume, all finite
invalid unless positive finite OHLC obey low<=open,close<=high and high-low>1e-12*max(1,abs(high),abs(low))

derived_features.availability: inherits the common completed-bar cutoff of both inputs
derived_features.missing_rule: invalid if either component is invalid

derived_features.availability: exact latest L_abs completed bars through c(t)
derived_features.missing_rule: every expected bar is required; no replacement, fill, or shorter window

derived_features.availability: all inputs known at c(t) for the current point-in-time universe
derived_features.formula: D=average_rank_map(E); A=average_rank_map(G); S=0.60*D+0.40*A for the reference
derived_features.missing_rule: symbol excluded unless both components are finite; entire request flat if fewer than 24 symbols remain

derived_features.availability: uses only finite scores at c(t)
derived_features.formula: sort (S,symbol) ascending; K=max(6,floor(N/4)); first K short, last K long; equal magnitude with B_eff=min(0.40,K*0.06)
derived_features.missing_rule: flat if N<24, 2K>N, either sleeve is infeasible, or final weight invariants fail

forbidden_inputs: evaluator position, fill, cost, equity, drawdown, or PnL

forward_diagnostics.availability: computed after a registered run from outcomes strictly after each decision; never passed to the strategy
forward_diagnostics.embargo: 30 calendar days for any outcome-based fold-local choice
forward_diagnostics.label: next scheduled 24h symbol return
forward_diagnostics.purge: daily reference labels are non-overlapping; reject malformed overlap

uplift.required: pooled U>0 and fold U>0 in at least four of six folds; composite rank IC>0 in at least four folds

deployable_requires: nonzero auction absorption component containing both taker flow and closing location
fixed weights independent of market/regime state
formal_pivot_required_for: removing taker flow or closing location from deployable absorption
adding funding or a market-state sleeve switch

allocation.equal_weight_rule: initialize each of K magnitudes to B_eff/K; reconcile B_eff-fsum(weights) in ASCII order within headroom/current weight
allocation.failure: flat whole portfolio if either sleeve or final invariant fails
allocation.final_invariants: each magnitude in [0,0.06], each side sum within 1e-12 of B_eff, disjoint K-name sleeves

arithmetic.sum: accurate deterministic float64 sum; time ascending and symbols ASCII ascending

auction_fields.smoothing: raw age weight 2^(-age/2), normalized by fsum, newest age zero

rank.definition: exact-equality average of one-based ascending positions, mapped to 2*(r-1)/(N-1)-1
rank.numeric_tie: symbol does not break the tie

windows.absorption: last L_abs exact bars, right endpoint included
windows.return: W=3*L_trend exact return-end bars through anchor; W+1 closes
windows.startup: no partial window, fill, interpolation, or older substitute

raw_inputs.coverage: authorized organizer-streamed 8h transaction bars for current eligible symbols
raw_inputs.lag: use only exact bars with close_time<=decision_time-8h
raw_inputs.missing_rule: no fill or interpolation; invalid/gapped/duplicate bar invalidates affected windows

raw_inputs.coverage: quote-denominated total and taker-buy transaction volume on the same completed 8h bar
raw_inputs.lag: use only exact bars with close_time<=decision_time-8h
raw_inputs.missing_rule: no fill; non-finite, non-positive total, or taker amount outside [0,total] invalidates the bar

raw_inputs.coverage: current point-in-time Top-40 intersected with executable symbols
raw_inputs.lag: available at decision; membership construction uses completed prior UTC days
raw_inputs.missing_rule: never synthesize membership; insufficient scoreable set requests flat
